verdict.rationale: Relay's support docs say applicants can check their application status anytime from the homepage while it is under review. They also give a typical 1–2 business day review window and an email notification when a decision is made. missing for 10: detail on what the status view shows (stages, any requests for more information), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can check my account application status while it's under review

citations.quote: You can check your status anytime from the homepage — we'll email you as soon as a decision is made.
